senses.gloss: 1. उप-स्-कर m. (for 2. See below) (n., MBh. v, 7234) any utensil, implement or instrument

an ingredient, condiment, spice, L.
N. of a Ṛṣi, BrahmaP.
ornament, decoration, T.
blame, censure, W.
2. उप-स्-कर m. the act of hurting, violating, T.
उप-स्-कार m. anything additional, a supplement, Kir. Comm. on Ragh. 7, &c.
decoration, decorating, T.
1. उप-स्-करण n. (for 2. See below) the act of decorating, embellishing, ornamenting
ornament, embellishment, T.
2. उप-स्-करण n. id., ib.
उप-स्-कृत mfn. furnished with, Suśr.; BhP.
added, supplied, Siddh.
prepared, arranged, elaborated
ornamented, embellished, decorated, adorned, MBh.; R.; Mn.; Bhartṛ. &c.
deformed, deranged, spoiled, Pāṇ.; MBh.; Mn.
assembled, Siddh.
blamed, censured, W.
उप-स्-कृति f. the act of preparing, adorning &c. Comm. on Pāṇ.
a supplement, anything additional, W.
उप-शाक॑ अस्, m. a helper, companion, RV. i, 33, 4.
उपासक mfn. serving, a servant, Kauś.; Kathās.
worshipping, a worshipper, follower, Mṛcch.
intent on, engaged or occupied with, Kap.

a Śūdra, L.

learning, acquisition, Mṛcch.; Kathās.

उप-शिक्षित mfn. learnt, studied
trained, MBh.; BhP.

उप-शद m. (perhaps fr. √ 2. शद्, ‘to excel’) a particular Ekāha or sacrifice during one day, ĀśvŚr.; Vait.
removal of an impediment to get children, Sāy. on TāṇḍyaBr. xix, 3, 1.
उप-सद mfn. one who goes near, W.

उप-शफ m. a hind hoof, Sāy. on TBr. ii, 6, 4.
उप-शम m. the becoming quiet, assuagement, alleviation, stopping, cessation, relaxation, intermission, MāṇḍUp.; Prab.; Pañcat. &c.
tranquillity of mind, calmness, patience, MBh. iii; Bhartṛ.; Śāntiś.
(in astron.) N. of the twentieth Muhūrta.
उप-शम—क्षय m. (with Jainas) the destruction (of activity &c.) through quietism, Sarvad.
उप-शम—वत् and उप-शम—शील, mfn. placid, calm, tranquil.
उप-शम—वत् and उप-शम—शील, mfn. placid, calm, tranquil.
उपशमायन mfn. going to or obtaining tranquillity of mind, BhP. v, 1, 29.
उप-शमन mf(ई)n. calming, appeasing, BhP.
उप-शमन n. the becoming extinct, ceasing, Nir.
calming, appeasing, mitigation, MBh.; BhP.; Suśr.; Pañcat.
an anodyne.
उप-शमनीय mfn. to be appeased or made quiet, Sāh.
(उपशमनीय fr. उप-शमन), serving as an anodyne, calming, appeasing, Car.
उप-शान्त mfn. calmed, appeased, pacified
calm, tranquil, BhP.; Kathās.
ceased, extinct, intermitted, R.; PraśnUp.
n. tranquillity, peace, Sukh. i.
उप-शान्त—वैर mfn. one whose enmity has ceased, reconciled, pacified, VarBṛS.
उपशान्तात्मन् mfn. one whose mind is pacified, placid, BhP.
उप-शान्ति f. cessation, intermission, remission, Suśr.; Ragh.; Hit. &c.
tranquillity, calmness.

tame
उपशान्तिन् m. a tame elephant, L.
उप-शामक mfn. calming, quieting, affording repose, making patient, Lalit.
उप-शय See उप-√ शी.
उप-शय॑ mfn. lying near at hand or close by, lying ready for use, ŚBr.; ŚāṅkhŚr.
उप-शय॑ (अस्), m. one of the Yūpas (or posts to which the sacrificial animal is tied), TS. vi, 6, 4, 4
the lying near or by the side of
a kind of hole in the ground (placed near the track of wild animals, for a hunter to conceal himself in Mall. on Śiś. ii, 80)
(in med.) the allaying (of diseases) by suitable remedies, suitableness, usefulness, advantageous medicine, Car.
the liking, predilection (of a sick person as for coolness &c.), ib.
diagnosis by the effect of certain articles of food or medicine, W.
उप-शाय &c. See उप-√ शी.
उप-शाय m. (ifc.) the turn for lying down or sleeping with, Pāṇ. iii, 3, 39 (cf. राजोपोशाय.)
उप-शया॑ (आ॑), f. (scil. मृद्) a piece of clay prepared and ready for use, ŚBr.; KātyŚr.
उप-शरदम् ind. (fr. शरद्, g. शरद्-आदि, Pāṇ. v, 4, 107), at or near the autumn.
उप-शल्य m. a small spear or lance tipped with iron, MBh. iii, 641
उप-शल्य n. a neighbouring district, environs, the ground near a village, Daś.; Ragh.
the ground at the base or edge of a mountain, Śiś. v, 8.
उप-शल्यक n. a small piece of ground near a village, Kād.
उप-शाखा f. a smaller branch of a tree, little branch, BhP. iv, 31, 14; Sāy.
उप-√ शान्त्व् See उप-√ सान्त्व्.
उप-शाल n. a place or court in front of a house, Kauś.
उप-शालम् ind. (fr. शाला, Pāṇ. vi, 2, 121) near a house.
उप-शास्त्र n. a minor science or treatise, L.
उप-शिक्षण n. taking into discipleship or apprenticeship, ĀpŚr., Sch.
उप-√ शिङ्घ् P. -शिङ्घति, to smell at, kiss, Bhaṭṭ.
उप-शिङ्घन n. (in med.) anything given to smell at, Suśr. ii, 515, 11
(-शिंहन, -सिंहन are wrong readings.)
उप-शिरस् ind. upon the head, Kauś. 86.
उप-शिव m. N. of a man.
उप-शिष्य m. the pupil of a pupil, Prab.
उप-शय—त्व॑ n. the being a particular sacrificial post, TS. vi, 6, 6, 4.
उप-शय—स्थ mfn. lying in ambush (as a hunter), Śiś. ii, 80.
उपशायक mf(इका)n. sleeping alternately with, Bhaṭṭ.
उपशायक m. N. of a man, VārP.
उप-शायिन् mfn. lying near to or by the side of KātyŚr.
lying, sleeping, R.
lying down, going to bed, MBh.
allaying, tranquillizing, anything that calms &c.
(in med.) composing, narcotic, W.

उपशायि-ता, f. or उपशायि-त्व, n. tranquillization, calming
 means of allaying disease (as diet &c.), W.

उपशायि-ता, f. or उपशायि-त्व, n. tranquillization, calming
 means of allaying disease (as diet &c.), W.
उप-शी॑वन् mf(˚वरी)n. lying near or by the side of MaitrS. ii, 13, 16; Kāṭh.
उप-शीर्षक n. a kind of disease of the head, ŚārṅgS.
उप-शुनम् (fr. श्वन्) ind. near a dog, Pāṇ. v, 4, 77.

उप-√ शुभ् Ā. -शोभते (p. -शुम्भमान, BhP.) to be beautiful or brilliant, BhP. v, 17, 13; Hit. :
Caus. P. -शोभयति, to adorn, ornament, MBh.; VarBṛS. &c.
उप-शोभन n. the act of adorning, ornamenting, R.; BhP.
1. उप-शोभा (for 2. See s.v.) f. ornament, Śiś. xiii, 36.
2. उप-शोभा (for 1. See col. 1) f. secondary ornament or decoration, AgP.; Hcat.
उप-शोभिका f. ornament, decoration, AgP.
उप-शोभित mfn. adorned, ornamented, decorated, MBh.; MārkP.; Suśr.; Pañcat. &c.
उपशोभिन् mfn. of beautiful appearance, brilliant, Kathās.

उप-√ शुष् P. -शुष्यति, to dry up, TS. iii, 1, 10, 3; Suśr.; Car. :
Caus. -शोषयति, to cause to dry up or shrink, make dry or withered, Āp.; MBh.; Kathās.
उप-शुष्क mfn. dry, ib.
उप-शोष mfn. drying up, withering, R. (B.).
उप-शोषण mfn. the act of causing to dry up or shrink, Suśr.; Prab.
उप-शोषित mfn. made dry, dried, dry, MBh.; Suśr.
उप-शैल m. a hill, Hcat.
उप-√ श्च्युत् or -√ श्चुत् P. -श्च्योतति, to ooze or trickle down, fall in drops, MW.
उप-√ श्रम् P. -श्राम्यति, to rest, repose, Kauś.
उप-श्री f. an over-garment (fitting closely), KauṣUp.
उ॑प-श्रित mfn. placed near, brought to the attention of RV. vii, 86, 8
leaning towards or upon, TS.; VS.; KātyŚr.
उपा-श्रित mfn. lying or resting upon, leaning against, clinging to, ŚāṅkhGṛ.; KaṭhUp.; R.
having recourse to, relying upon, taking refuge with, MBh.; Bhag.; Kathās. &c.
taking one's self to
approached, arrived at, abiding in MBh.; BhP.; VarBṛS. &c.
anything against which one leans or upon which one rests, Uttarar.
उप-√ श्रु P. -शृणोति, to listen to, give ear to, hear, RV.; AV. xii, 4, 27; xx, 27, 1; ŚBr.; TāṇḍyaBr.; TBr.; ChUp.; MBh. &c.
उप-√ स्रु P. (Impv. 3. pl. -स्रवन्तु) to stream or flow upon or towards, VS. xxxv, 20.
उप-श्रुत mfn. listened to, heard, MBh.; Hariv.; BhP.
promised, agreed, L.
उ॑प-श्रुति f. giving ear to, listening attentively, RV. i, 10, 3; viii, 8, 5; 34, 11; AV. ii, 16, 2; xvi, 2, 5
range of hearing, ŚBr.; ŚāṅkhŚr.
hearing, BhP.
rumour, report, MBh. v, 30, 5 (ed. Bomb.; अप-श्रुति, ed. Calc. v, 871)
a kind of supernatural oracular voice (answering questions about future events, and supposed to be uttered by an idol after mystic invocations, Vidhāna-pārijāta, T.), MBh.; Kād. &c., (cf. शकुनोप˚)
उ॑प-श्रुति m. N. of an evil spirit, PārGṛ. i, 16, 23.
उप-श्रु॑त्य ind.p. having listened to
listening to, hearing, AV. xii, 4, 28; MBh.; BhP. &c.
उप-श्रोतृ॑ ता, m. a listener, hearer, RV. vii, 23, 1; TS.; ŚāṅkhŚr.; Vait.
उप-श्लाघा f. boasting, brag, swagger, GopBr.

उप-√ श्लिष् P. -श्लिष्यति, to come near to or into close contact with, cling to, MBh.; Daś. :
Caus. -श्लेषयति, to bring near or into close contact, Vikr.
उपा-√ श्लिष् to embrace, MārkP.
उ॑प-श्लिष्ट mfn. brought near or into close contact, contiguous, adjoining, TBr. iii, 8, 17, 4; Pañcat.
उपा-श्लिष्ट mfn. one who has clasped or laid hold of MBh. i, 1125.
उप-श्लेष m. close contact, contiguity, Pat.
embrace, Prab.
उप-श्लेषण n. the act of joining or fixing on, sewing together, Sarvad.
उप-श्लोक m. N. of the father of the tenth Manu, BhP. viii, 13, 21.
उप-श्लोकय Nom. (fr. श्लोक, Pāṇ. iii, 1, 25) P. -श्लोकयति, to praise in Ślokas.
उप-√ श्वस् Caus. (Impv. 2. sg. -श्वासय) to fill with roarings or noise, RV. vi, 47, 29.
उप-श्वस॑ m. breeze, draught of air, AV. xi, 1, 12.
उप-ष्टम्भ &c. See उप-स्तम्भ.
उप-ष्टु॑त् See उप-√ स्तु.
उप-ष्टु॑त् mfn. praised, invoked (= उपस्तूयमान, Sāy.), RV. ix, 87, 9.
उप॑स् only loc. उप॑सि [= उपस्थे, Nir.; Sāy.], ‘in the lap’, RV. v, 43, 7; x, 27, 13.
√ 1. उपाश् (उप- 1. अश्) P. Ā. -अश्नोति, -अश्नुते, to reach, obtain, meet with, MBh.; Mn.
√ 2. उपाश् (उप- 2. अश्) P. -अश्नाति, to eat, taste, enjoy, MBh.
√ 1. उपास् (उप- 1. अस्) P. (Pot. 1. pl. -स्याम) to be near to or together with (acc.), RV. ii, 27, 7.

√ 2. उपास् (उप- 2. अस्) P. -अस्यति, to throw off, throw or cast down upon, throw under, AV. vi, 42, 2; ŚBr.; KātyŚr.: Ā. -अस्यते, to throw (anything) under one's self, TS. i, 6, 10, 1; MaitrS. ii, 1, 1.
उप-सं-√ यम्
उप-संयत mfn. closely joined or fixed together, wedged in Suśr. 101, 7.
उप-संयम m. bringing into close contact, wedging in L.
उप-संयमन n. the act of fixing one thing to another
a means of fastening together, L.
उप-सं-√ या P. (Impv. 2. pl. -यात) to come in a body towards, AV. vi, 73, 1.
उप-सं-√ युज् Caus. -योजयति, to furnish with, MBh. xiii.
उप-संयोग m. a secondary or subordinate connection, modification, Nir.

उप-सं-वाद m. (√ वद्), agreeing together, agreement, Pāṇ. iii, 4, 8.

उप-संवीत mfn. wrapped up, covered, MBh. xv.
उप-संव्यान n. an undergarment, Pāṇ. i, 1, 36.
उप-सं-√ व्रज् P. -व्रजति, to step into, enter, Mn. vi, 51.
उप-सं-√ शंस् P. -शंसति, to recite in addition, add, ŚBr. xiii, 5, 1, 8.

to devote one's self to, serve, attend, MBh. xiii.
उप-सं-√ श्लिष्
उप-संश्लिष्ट mfn. united, joined, coherent.

उप-सं-√ सृ
उप-संसृत्य ind.p. having stepped near to, approaching, BhP. iii, 21, 47.
उप-सं-√ सृज्
उप-संसृष्ट mfn. united with
burdened, afflicted, blasted (by a curse), BhP. xi, 30, 2
joined together
effected, produced, BhP.
उप-सं-√ सृप्
उप-संसृप्य ind.p. having crept towards, ŚBr. iv.
उप-संस्कार m. a secondary or supplementary Saṃskāra (q.v.), Sāy. on TBr. ii, 1, 4.
उप-संस्कृत mfn. prepared, dressed, cooked (as food), MBh.; Suśr. 335, 14; Car.
prepared, arranged, adorned, Suśr.
उप-सं-√ स्था
उप-संस्थित mfn. one who has stopped, Hariv. 9700.
उप-संहत mfn. collected, Divyāv.
उप-सं-हित See उप-सं-√ धा.
उप-संहित mfn. connected or furnished with, accompanied or surrounded by, having, possessing, MBh.
placed before one's self, taken into consideration, ib.
attached to, devoted, Car.
उप-संहरण n. the act of withdrawing &c., L.
उप-संहर्तव्य mfn. to be brought near, Lalit.
उप-संहार m. the act of withdrawing, withholding, taking away, MBh.
drawing towards one's self, bringing near, TPrāt.
summarizing, summing up, résumé, Vedāntas.; Nyāyak.
conclusion, end, epilogue, Kathās.; Sāh.; Sarvad. &c.
N. of the concluding chapters in several books
suppression, subduing
end, death, destruction, L.
that part of a drama which usually precedes the Bharata-vākya, Bhar.
उप-संहार—प्रकरण n. N. of wk.
उप-संहारिन् mfn. comprehending
exclusive, Tarkas.; Bhāṣāp. (with अन्˚ neg.)
उप-संहृत mfn. drawn near, brought into contact, TPrāt.
withheld, drawn back
stopped, interrupted, suppressed, BhP.; Kathās. Comm. on Mn.
absorbed, destroyed, NṛsUp.; MBh.; BhP.; Sarvad. &c.
dead
comprehended
excluded, L.
उप-संहृति f. comprehension
conclusion
(in dram.) the end or conclusion, the catastrophe (= निर्-वहण), Sāh. 332; Daśar.

उप-सं-√ कॢप् Caus. P. -कल्पयति, to put upon, set, cause to settle, MBh.;
to appoint, elect for, Gṛhyās.
उप-संकॢप्त mfn. put above, being above, BhP. iv, 9, 54.

उप-सं-√ क्रम् P. Ā. -क्रामति, -क्रमते, to step or go to the other side (or other world &c.), ŚBr. iv, xii; TUp.; Daś. &c.:
Caus. -क्रमयति, to cause to go to the other side, ŚBr. vi.
उप-संक्रमण n. the act of going over towards, Lalit.
g. व्युष्टादि, Pāṇ. v, 1, 97.
उप-संक्रान्त mfn. turned to, changed into (another meaning; as a word employed in another meaning), Pat.
उप-संक्रान्ति f. the being conveyed across, reaching the other side, VarBṛS.; Rājat.
उप-सं-क्षेप m. (√ क्षिप्), a concise abridgment or summary, an abstract compendium, R.
उप-सं-ख्यान n. (ख्या), the act of adding, annumeration, further enumeration, Kāty.; Pat.
reckoning along with.
उप-संख्येय mfn. to be added or enumerated in addition to (loc.), Pat.
उप-संगत mfn. come together, assembled, BhP.
united, joined (मिथुनाय, for sexual intercourse), MBh. i, 6897.
उप-संगमन n. the act of coming together, sexual union, Gaut. iv, 13.
उप-सं-√ ग्रह् Desid. P. -जिघृ-क्षति, to wish or intend to embrace (the feet of), Āp. i, 8, 19.
उप-संगृहीत mfn. seized, taken into custody, Pañcat.
उप-संगृह्य ind.p. taking hold of, clasping, embracing, ŚBr.; ŚāṅkhGṛ.; ĀśvGṛ.; Mn.
embracing (especially पादौ or पादयोः, the feet of a revered person; the word पादौ being not unfrequently omitted), PārGṛ.; Āp.; MBh.; Suśr. &c.
partaking of, receiving, accepting, MBh.; R.
getting or entering into, experiencing, MBh. xii
winning over, conciliating, propitiating, Daś.
उप-संग्रह m. the act of clasping round, embracing, embrace (esp. of the feet of a revered person), Pañcat.; Kathās.
respectful salutation, polite address (performed by touching the feet of the addressed person with one's hands), L.
clasping (a woman See दारोप˚)
bringing together, collecting, joining, R.; Nir.
a pillow, cushion, MBh. iv, 517.
उप-संग्रहण n. the act of clasping round, embracing (e.g. the feet), respectful salutation (by embracing the feet), Āp.; Gaut.; Mn.
उप-संग्राह्य mfn. (one whose feet are) to be embraced
to be saluted reverentially, respectable, venerable, Āp.; Mn.
उप-सं-घात m. (√ हन्), the act of collecting (one's ideas) Comm. on Nyāyad.

उप-√ सच् Ā. (3. pl. -स॑चन्ते impf. 3. pl. -असचन्त) to follow closely, RV. i, 190, 2; AV. xviii, 4, 40;
to pursue, AitBr. vi, 36, 2.

उप-सं-√ चर् P. -चरति, to approach, enter, AV. iii, 12, 1;
to approach (भर्तारम्, a husband sexually), VarBṛS.
उप-संचार m. access, entrance, Gobh. iv, 2, 7.
उप-√ सञ्ज् Ā. -सज्जते. to be attached to, fond of (loc.), BhP. xi, 26, 22.
उप-सक्त mfn. attached to, depending on (worldly desires), R.
उप-सं-√ जन् Ā. (fut. p. -जनिष्यमाण) to present one's self, appear, Paribh. 64.
उप-संजात mfn. appeared, present, ib.
2. उप-स॑द् mfn. approaching (respectfully), worshipping, serving, AV.; VS. xxx, 9
उप-स॑द् (त्), m. N. of a particular fire (different from the Gārhapatya, Dakṣiṇāgni, and Āhavanīya), VahniP.
उप-स॑द् (त्), f. attendance, worship, service, RV. ii, 6, 1
settlement (?), AV. vi, 142, 3
